text: Long catch up with Marta over coffee. Her cat Biscuit has kidney problems and goes back to the vet on November 4th. She's pretty shaken. Her brother Matteo passed his driving test on the second go, finally. He's moving into his own flat in Salford on December 1st and wants help with the van. I said I'd ask Ali if we can borrow his.

Ethan's puppy arrived Saturday, a spaniel called Pickle. He's knackered already. Zara reckons they should have waited till after his exams in May 2027 but he's having none of it. His sister Lena is coming to stay over half term to help with the training. Ethan wants to bring Pickle round to meet our cat next weekend, which could go either way.
Need to ring Dorota before her audition on Nov 12. She's terrified, hasn't slept properly all week. Her mum's driving her up to Manchester for it.
Bilal got his results today, three A*s. His dad apparently cried in the car park. Must send him a card this week.

Caught up with Aditi and her husband Vikram. They're off to Lisbon 2 November 2026 for their anniversary. Their dog Rolo is going to Aditi's sister for the week. Vikram says she's been stressing about leaving him.

Graham's theory test got moved to 12/3. He's been doing the app every night on the train. His instructor reckons he'll be ready for the practical by February 2027. His mum Dorota has been taking him out in her car on Sundays, which by all accounts is stressful for both of them.
Chioma and Tobi are moving in together after Christmas. She mentioned Tobi's allergic to cats, which is awkward given Mango. Pop round before they go, maybe the weekend of the 15th.
Lena's lovely. Teaches violin, vegetarian, mad about birdwatching. Met her through Erin at the quiz.
Dimitri messaged, the stag do in Riga is off, his brother and Shanice split up last month. He sounded rough about it. I should call him this weekend.
Mai's rabbit Toffee turns five on Oct 28. She's doing a little party for him, honestly. Thinking a bag of those fancy hay treats as a joke present.
Pick up the dog's flea tablets and book the car in for its MOT before November 30th.
Malik has his grade 8 piano exam on December 9th. Second attempt, he failed by two marks in June. His teacher thinks he's ready but he isn't so sure. Wish him luck the night before!

Just off the phone with Agnieszka. Her dad had his hip op on Tuesday and is home now, grumpy but walking. She's back at work Monday. Her son Ali starts his GCSE mocks on 11/17 and is apparently not revising at all, so she's tearing her hair out. Send her the Spanish flashcards Luca used last year. Also she wants to do lunch in early December, probably the 6th.
Anika's into bouldering now, goes three nights a week. Works at the council planning office.
Hiroshi Tanaka's son got into the Royal Ballet School! Starts September 2027. Hiroshi was beaming.
Caitlin's kitten has been off her food since Thursday, vet tomorrow at 9. Text her afterwards to see what they said.

Ximena failed her driving test this morning, minor on a roundabout. She's gutted and already rebooked for Jan 8. Maybe take her for a drink Friday. She's had her since the spring, a tabby called Fig. Her flatmate Agnieszka is away so she's on her own with it. Offer to go with her if she needs a lift.
Miriam is expecting! Due May 14. Her and Lwazi are telling family at her mum's 60th on the 1st.
Note to self: dentist moved to 10/29, 3:30.
Bethany said Matilda, her eldest, has a cello recital on Dec 2nd at the town hall. I'm going with Bethany. Matilda's a bag of nerves apparently.
Tiago's new job at the bank starts on November 3rd. His wife Dana has her citizenship test the same week, poor things.

Drinks with Erin and Shanice last night. Erin's getting her puppy, a cockapoo, on 18 December 2026, just in time for Christmas chaos. Shanice is doing the bar exam in February and is quietly panicking. She's moved back to her parents' to save money. Must remember to check in on Shanice nearer the time.
Ali's dog Bruno got hit by a car last week. He's ok, broken leg, but Ali's been a mess. Drop round with something on Sunday.
Uncle Graham's 70th is on March 21 2027. Cousin Luca is organising, wants us to chip in for a watch.
Spoke to Vikram briefly. He's been signed off work with his back, again.
Remember Lwazi's driving test is on 11/6. Text him good luck that morning.
Zara's thinking about doing the Edinburgh marathon in May 2027. Hates running, loves a challenge. Typical.
Mrs Popescu next door says her parrot Coco is 40 this year. Forty! She also mentioned her grandson Matteo is coming over from Bucharest on Dec 20 for a month.
Dorota got the part! Call her tonight.

Chat with Ethan after five-a-side. His girlfriend Caitlin had her nursing finals results on Friday, passed everything. They're celebrating with a meal on Nov 8 and he asked if we want to come. He's also thinking about proposing next spring, maybe April 2027, but not a word. Caitlin's after a decent coffee machine apparently, so a hint for Christmas.
Book flights for Nana's visit, she lands June 3rd.
Matilda's guinea pig died over half term. She's eight, took it hard. Bethany thinks they'll get another in the new year.

Anika and Hiroshi have their wedding on 5 September 2027. Save the dates are out. Venue in the Lakes. Anika's dad is doing a reading. Hiroshi's lot are flying in from Osaka in August 2027 and making a holiday of it. Should look at B&Bs nearby before they all go.
Mai said her sister Aditi is nervous about her PhD viva on December 11th. Mai's flying over for it. Should send Aditi a little good luck card, maybe flowers after.
Bilal's cat Shadow has gone missing since Monday. Leafleted the whole street. He's in bits. Share his post on the neighbourhood group.
Dana and Tiago's little one, Lena, starts nursery after Christmas. Dana's dreading it more than Lena is.
Rang Miriam to check how the scan went. All fine, baby's measuring well. She's still sick most mornings though.
Note: Dimitri Popescu, works with Graham at the depot. Supports Arsenal. Lactose intolerant, so no cheese board when he comes.
Mum's birthday on Nov 19. Order flowers by the 15th and book the restaurant.
Marta's cat Biscuit pulled through, vet says stable kidneys for now. Biscuit's tenth birthday is on 12/12 and she's doing a cake. A cake, for a cat.
Malik "Mal" Walsh, met at Agnieszka's leaving do. Plays drums in a covers band, gig on Nov 22 at the Crown. Said I'd go.
Ximena passed!! Second time lucky. Send congrats and ask when she's getting the car.

Erin's audition for the orchestra was moved from Oct 30 to November 6th. She's had extra lessons every weekend since September. Her teacher, Mr Brennan, thinks she's got a real shot. Her partner Tobi says she's barely eating from nerves. I should text her the day before, and arrange a celebratory dinner for after whatever happens.
Lwazi and Miriam's dog Ziggy is turning one on Halloween. They've ordered him a bandana.
Luca's results day is August 13, 2027. He wants to do vet science.
Groceries, post office, and the boiler service 11/4 between 8 and 12.
Quick call with Chioma. Her nan's in hospital with pneumonia since the weekend. She's driving up to Leeds Thursday. Ask her about it next week.

Shanice's dog Pepper had her puppies on Sunday, six of them! She wants homes for them by early January. Graham's family might take one, his kids have been begging. Tell Graham about it at work tomorrow.

Agnieszka's son Ali is doing a drama school audition in London on February 3 2027. He's quiet about it but practising every evening. She's taking him down on the train. His sister Zara is helping with lines.
Met Dr Fischer at the open evening, Hiroshi's old supervisor. She's into orchids and has two greyhounds.
Didn't get round to calling Caitlin back about Thursday. Do it first thing tomorrow.
Vikram's mum is having a cataract op on Nov 25. He's taking a week off to look after her.
Tobi's sitting his accountancy exams on December 1st and 3rd. Says he's fine but he's revising till 2am, so probably not fine.
Dinner with Matteo and Ximena on Saturday was cancelled, Ximena has flu. Rearrange for next month, maybe Nov 14.
Bethany Hughes, Matilda's mum from swimming. Works nights as a paramedic. Lovely, bit shy.
Dimitri sent pics of the new kitten. Called her Olive. Collects her on the 26th.

Long walk with Zara and her dog Monty. She's had a rough few months, her dad died in July and now work wants her back full time from 1/5. She's thinking of going part time instead. Her brother Ethan is coming down at Christmas to help clear the house. I'd like to visit her before then, maybe early December. Need to ask her about the new job thing in a couple of weeks.
Last day before Grandad moves into the care home on 2 December 2026. Order the frame for his photos.
Aditi passed her viva with minor corrections! Graduation is July 2027. Mai's organising a surprise dinner on the 20th.
Phoned Matteo. His driving test is March 2027, finally booked. Lessons twice a week with his uncle. Ask how the next lesson goes.
